title: Shared Schema Index
description: Catalog of reusable shared type schemas available for $ref references across the TarlaAnaliz contract repository.

schemas.name: Money
schemas.description: Monetary value with currency and tax information. Use for any field representing a price, payment, or financial amount.

schemas.name: Address
schemas.description: Postal address for billing and operational purposes. Includes optional GeoPoint coordinates. PII-minimized.

schemas.name: GeoJSON
schemas.description: Full GeoJSON types: Feature, FeatureCollection, and all geometry types (Point, LineString, Polygon, Multi*, GeometryCollection). Use for spatial data representation.
